description: DRAGSTER runs the shared race engine, so every ZOOM ZOO race guard applies from end-1601 (ZOOM ZOO's end-1649 on DRAGSTER's 48-frame-earlier menu path) with the same value, except these scenario and playfield words. Each takes DRAGSTER's value on the authenticated DRAGSTER originals, and native code derives it rather than assuming ZOOM ZOO's (R-0038).
